decisions.reason: The iOS optimization state already specifies using a YouTube video instead of packaged tutorial images; selecting one shared video for all app versions changes the separate content-delivery Requirement but does not alter the size-optimization strategy.

The Android optimization state already specifies using a YouTube video instead of tutorial images; the shared video and its URL concern How-To-Use content delivery and do not change the existing package-size strategy.

Tutorial-specific localization attributes had already been removed when tutorial images were replaced by a YouTube video. Choosing one shared How-To-Use video does not change the remaining iOS localization coverage, language set, RTL support, or localized social-media links.

Tutorial localization had already been removed from the Android localization state after the switch to video. Using one shared video for all app versions does not change the remaining localization workflow, coverage, supported languages, or localization priority.
